steps.journal: Bring the starcrab glog to Kuthrak.
steps.says: Ahh. The froglok prisoners know of one called Grothmal.

steps.journal: Speak with the froglok prisoner.
steps.says: Grothmal comes out at night in the mushroom patch west of the war camp.

steps.journal: Take the ruby pendant from Grothmal at the mushroom patch at night.
Bring the ruby pendant to Hierophant Koligo.
steps.says: Take the news to Jurglash.

steps.journal: Return to Warlord Jurglash.
steps.says: Good.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/grobb/warrior.json, # Level 10 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Swillmaster is Swillmaster Sturg here; its Crazed Troll's slap is left out. The guide names no reward but the experience; the experience is the one every city gives for this level.

quests.name: Scornblade D'Eleth
quests.offer: Scornblade D'Eleth in Neriak wants a troll for a job. Waysender Zapgit by the exit tunnel will send you.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Speak with Scornblade D`Eleth.
steps.says: Dragoon X'Talin, in his tower up the river west of Neriak, needs help first.

steps.journal: Speak with Dragoon X'Talin.
steps.says: Bring me three shadow cub pelts from east of my tower.

steps.journal: Take three shadow cub pelts from the shadow cubs east of X'Talin's tower.
Bring three shadow cub pelts to Dragoon X'Talin.
steps.says: Good. Go back to the Scornblade.

steps.journal: Return to Scornblade D'Eleth.
steps.says: Now kill the troll at the far end of the arena.

steps.journal: Take the troll's shackle from the troll at the far end of the arena.
Bring the troll's shackle to Scornblade D`Eleth.
steps.says: Well fought. Go home to Bugrish.

steps.journal: Return to Underlord Bugrish.
steps.says: Good work.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/grobb/warrior.json, # Level 13 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Waysender Zapgit's trips are the player's own (his usual menu); the steps are the people at either end. The guide's Underlord Burgish is Underlord Bugrish here. The guide names no reward but the experience; the experience is the one every city gives for this level. The arena troll is unnamed in the guide.

quests.name: Weapons for Grobb
quests.offer: Smithy Cragis in Clagga Village, north-west along the road toward Guk, will make weapons for us. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Speak with Smithy Cragis.
steps.says: Kill Bogscraper, the alligator in the swamps round the village, and bring me its tooth.

steps.journal: Take the bogscraper tooth from Bogscraper in the swamps round Clagga Village.
Bring the bogscraper tooth to Smithy Cragis.
steps.says: Now see Torgot in the Basher Enclave.

steps.journal: Speak with Torgot.
steps.says: Kill a lizardman fanatic north of the enclave. Kill the caitiffs in the ring if none is there.

steps.journal: Take the fanatic drum from the lizardman fanatics north of the Basher Enclave.
Bring the fanatic drum to Torgot.
steps.says: Good. Go back to Cragis.

steps.journal: Return to Smithy Cragis.
steps.says: Ask Scornblade J'Naris in Hazinak if he will send the weapons.

steps.journal: Speak with Scornblade J'Naris.
steps.says: The weapons will go.

steps.journal: Return to Smithy Cragis.
steps.says: Good. Here is a tunic for your trouble.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/grobb/warrior.json, # Level 15 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Underlord Burgrish is Underlord Bugrish here, and its Turgot is Torgot. The guide's tunic and Torgot's scroll are unnamed. The guide names no reward but the experience; the experience is the one every city gives for this level.

quests.name: Seer Crelga's Trials
quests.offer: Seer Crelga, in a hut on the east side of Honjour, has trials for you. Waysender Zapgit will send you.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Speak with Seer Crelga.
steps.says: First trial: kill farmers south of Honjour, past the windmill, for three bag of grains.

steps.journal: Take three bag of grains from the farmers south of Honjour (not the odd farmers).
Bring three bag of grains to Seer Crelga.
steps.says: Second trial: kill a froglok ton in the caves south-west of Honjour.

steps.journal: Take the froglok sword from the froglok ton in the caves south-west of Honjour.
Bring the froglok sword to Seer Crelga.
steps.says: Third trial: the festering root of the Wailing Tree. Ask Scornblade J'Naris in Hazinak where it stands.

steps.journal: Speak with Scornblade J'Naris.
steps.says: Nalzik P'Thek in Freeport knows the way.

steps.journal: Speak with Nalzik P`Thek.
steps.says: The Wailing Tree stands in the Green Rift, south-west of Neriak. The root spirit lives in the tunnels beneath it.

steps.journal: Take the festering root from the root spirit in the tunnels under the Wailing Tree.
Bring the festering root to Warlord Jurglash.
steps.says: The festering root. Choose your path.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/grobb/warrior.json, # Level 20 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Waysender Zapgit's trips are the player's own (his usual menu); the steps are the people at either end. The guide's seer of Hagley is Seer Crelga here, and its Wilting Tree the Wailing Tree. The guide offers a choice; this gives the first: Bellow, or Pillar of Might.
